policy.quote: captured best-price YES bid/ask; one paired hypothetical quote per comparable exchange every 30 seconds
policy.stress: separate one-tick each-way deduction of 0.010000 SUSQie per unit
policy.fillProxy: one captured same-market print at least one tick through limit after activation; proxy only, no aggressor side or queue position
policy.entryAndExit: entry joins captured best bid/ask; liquidation crosses to captured future bid/ask after event horizon and 3-second post-receipt response
policy.marketClusterUncertainty: cluster-robust CR1 standard error of the sample-weighted mean by stable marketId; Kish effective independent-market counts use per-market quote or markout sample counts; approximate normal 95% interval only when at least two market clusters contribute

scopeComparability.poolingRule: only exact tournamentId/marketId/exchangeId identities in every frozen source are pooled; exchange-id remaps are rejected; uncertainty is clustered by marketId, not quote

developmentDays.fold: development only; descriptive and not independent validation

flowCalibration.method: each stable market/exchange identity uses its own chronological development-only quote-flow terciles; no cross-market feature pooling

developmentDays.fold: development only; descriptive and not independent validation

flowCalibration.method: each stable market/exchange identity uses its own chronological development-only quote-flow terciles; no cross-market feature pooling

featureCalibration.method: each stable market/exchange identity uses its own chronological development-only quote-flow terciles; no cross-market feature pooling

developmentFeatureCalibration.method: each stable market/exchange identity uses its own chronological development-only quote-flow terciles; no cross-market feature pooling

cellDisclosure.selection: every prespecified overall, spread, queue-ahead and aligned-flow cell is included, including empty cells; no best-cell selection or holdout-driven parameter choices
cellDisclosure.flowBins: market/exchange-specific terciles fitted only from that identity’s development quote features; ties use evaluator’s strict-below/equal/strictly-above rule
cellDisclosure.counts: quote counts and proxy fills are descriptive opportunities; repeated quotes are dependent and are not independent trials
cellDisclosure.uncertainty: effective market counts and clustered intervals are descriptive, approximate, and not a profitability guarantee

limits: All results are captured-book counterfactual proxies, not accepted contest orders or realized fills; queue priority, aggressor side, capital constraints, and venue execution are unknown.
Each source has isolated receipt/revision state and all pending hypothetical quotes are cleared at every capture boundary; markouts are receipt/response gated and censored across gaps.
October 13 is used once as the final chronological holdout; only configuration headers were inspected before the frozen run. Flow cutpoints come from October 5–6 development quote features.
No fees are assumed; one-tick-each-way stress is separate. These per-unit markouts are not portfolio returns.
The common identity intersection avoids pooling changed contracts. Market-cluster uncertainty accounts for within-market quote dependence but not shared tournament-wide shocks or model selection.
The two earlier capture days are development diagnostics, not independent validation. Even positive proxy markouts would not establish profitability.
